context: Maintainer reviews and merges #1592 (squash). Agent/maintainer then re-reads origin/develop workflow + runs a cheap open-PR smoke or gh api check that non-draft open no longer gets auto_merge from the bot without ready_for_review.
description:
PR #1592 (fix/auto-merge-enablement-hold) implements the workflow half of the auto-merge hold: enable only on ready_for_review, never on opened/synchronize. It touches .github/workflows/auto-merge-on-open.yml so the soundness path withholds auto-merge; human merge is required.

Until it lands, develop still arms non-draft non-soundness PRs on open (live proof during the batch: bots auto-armed non-soundness PRs). Tracker item auto-merge-workflow-defeats-the-makefile-hold-20260805 was completed at PR open per batch skill, so production closeout is this land step.

After merge: confirm develop workflow enable if: requires ready_for_review; smoke that a new non-draft open does not arm.

preserves.behavior: Do not force-merge with failing required checks; do not disable soundness withholding to land

verifications.command: gh pr view 1592 --repo joeharris76/BenchBox --json state --jq .state | grep -qx MERGED

verifications.description: develop workflow enable if requires ready_for_review

work_units.evidence: origin/develop auto-merge-on-open.yml Enable if: steps.soundness.outputs.soundness_path != 'true' && github.event.action == 'ready_for_review'
work_units.summary: Verify develop workflow enable step requires ready_for_review only
